title: Tier 3 ECEF tile pipeline — Phase 1 (TileScheme abstraction + source-honest principle)
scope: Two sequential PRs off feature/ecef-tile-pipeline-phase1 branch. PR #1 (Phase 1a) = polar-cap auto-call removal + setPolarCapsEnabled deprecation via xlog.warn no-op. PR #2 (Phase 1b) = TileScheme single-variant union + readonly scheme field on TileSourceMeta + 4 backend population + VirtualCatalogAdapter lazy throwing proxy + TileCatalog.getSourceScheme accessor. Mercator (projType 0) byte-identity required on BOTH PRs — no snapshot regeneration. Architect+Critic consensus reached after 3 plan iterations.

runtime/src/engine/map.ts setPolarCapsEnabled method body is a no-op + one-shot xlog.warn(...) call using xlog imported from runtime/src/engine/log.ts (NOT raw console.warn). The warning fires only once per session via a module-scoped _polarCapsWarned flag.

setPolarCapsEnabled DOES NOT throw — calling map.setPolarCapsEnabled(true) returns normally.
